ui.title: Patient chatbot
ui.welcomeTitle: Let’s take it one question at a time.
ui.welcomeCopy: Describe the fictional case naturally. The bot remembers what you’ve shared, groups related questions, and keeps everything under one stub.
ui.languageLabel: Which language should the bot use?
ui.languageHelp: The questions will follow your selected language. You can reply in any language variant or mix languages; your original wording is kept.
ui.syntheticConfirmation: I’m using a fictional case, without names or personal identifiers.
ui.adultConfirmation: The fictional patient is aged 18 or above.
ui.replyPlaceholder: Tell me in your own words…
ui.inputHelp: You can share several details in one reply.
ui.reviewConfirmation: I reviewed this fictional case. It contains no identifiers, measured vital signs, examination findings, test results or answer-key labels.
ui.wait: Your answers are saved. This can take up to 95 seconds; please keep this tab open.
ui.processing: Your screening is being processed. This page checks for the saved result automatically. Staff can inspect your stub if it stays unfinished.
ui.endConfirmation: End this browser’s access to :stub? Staff will keep its saved history. A new conversation receives a new stub.
ui.newCase: End this conversation / start a new case
ui.disclaimer: Fictional-case thesis demo · Preliminary screening only · Clinical review pending
ui.reviewHelp: These details came from your replies. Blank fields mean unknown. You can correct them before submitting.

messages.welcome: Welcome. Your stub is :stub. I’ll ask about the fictional patient one topic at a time, with a follow-up if an answer needs more detail. You can mix languages in your replies. Choose Unknown when the case does not provide the information.
messages.ready: Thank you. Review your answers above, then submit this fictional case for preliminary screening. Staff can see your conversation and result under your stub number.
messages.failure: Your conversation is saved. Automated screening could not be completed, so no priority was assigned. Staff can inspect the issue using your stub :stub.
messages.researchOutput: This is an unvalidated research output for a fictional case.
messages.exploratoryOutput: Exploratory Luna-only result for a fictional case. Study criteria are pending clinical review.

errors.stale: This question has already changed. Refresh the conversation before replying.
errors.adult: This demo is for fictional adults aged 18 and above.
errors.age: Enter a whole-number age in years, or choose Unknown.
errors.message: Write a reply or choose Unknown.
errors.confirmation: Please confirm this statement before continuing.

questions.age: How old is the fictional patient? Enter their age in years, or choose Unknown. This demo is for adults aged 18 and above.
questions.reported_sex: What sex does the patient report? Choose Unknown if it is not given.
questions.main_complaint: What is the main reason for this visit? Describe the main complaint in a few words.
questions.symptom_description: Describe how the patient feels in their own words. Include what the symptom feels like and where it happens, if stated. Leave out names, contact details, measured vital signs, examination findings and test results.
questions.other_symptoms: Are there any other reported symptoms? Say none only if the case explicitly reports none; otherwise choose Unknown.
questions.known_conditions: What existing medical conditions does the patient report? Give only conditions stated in the case.
questions.allergies: What allergies does the patient report? If the case does not say, choose Unknown.
questions.maintenance_medications: What maintenance medications does the patient report taking? Include only names stated in the case.
questions.onset: When did the symptoms start? Give the reported time or event when they began.
questions.duration: How long have the symptoms lasted? Include minutes, hours or days if known.
questions.reported_severity: How does the patient describe the severity? Use their words or a pain score only if the case provides one.
questions.worsening: Does the patient say the symptoms are getting worse, improving or staying the same?
questions.tests_completed: Were any tests already completed? Give test names only, without results or measured values.
questions.tests_requested: Has a clinician requested any tests? Give their names or request context only, without results.
questions.medical_devices: Does the patient report using any medical device or catheter? Give its name or type if stated.

followUps.main_complaint: What specific problem brought the patient here, and which part of the body is affected, if known? Give only details in the case.
followUps.symptom_description: Can you describe that feeling more clearly—where it happens, what it feels like, or what the patient has difficulty doing? Include only what the case says, or continue without more details.
followUps.other_symptoms: Which other symptoms does the patient report? Please name them without adding symptoms that are not in the case.
followUps.known_conditions: Which existing conditions does the patient report? Give their names if stated; otherwise continue without more details.
followUps.allergies: What is the patient allergic to? Give the substance or medicine name if it is stated in the case.
followUps.maintenance_medications: Which maintenance medications are reported? Give only names that are known; do not guess a name or dose.
followUps.onset: Can the case give a more specific starting time, such as today, yesterday or after a stated event? If not, continue without more details.
followUps.duration: How long is that, and in what unit—minutes, hours, days or longer? Use only the duration stated in the case.
followUps.reported_severity: How does the patient describe how strong the symptom is or how it affects usual activities? Do not make up a pain score.
followUps.worsening: What change does the patient report? Describe how the symptom has changed, if the case gives that detail.
followUps.tests_completed: Which tests were completed? Give names only, without results, findings or measured values.
followUps.tests_requested: Which tests did the clinician request, or what request was reported? Do not include results or suggest new tests.
followUps.medical_devices: What medical device or catheter is reported? Give its name or type only if the case provides it.

conversation.welcome: Hi! Your stub is :stub. Tell me about the fictional case in your own words. I’ll pick up the details you share and ask only for what’s still missing. You can skip anything you don’t know.
conversation.opening: What brings you in today? Tell me what you’re feeling.
conversation.ready: Thanks, that’s enough to review. I’ve put your answers together below. Check or correct anything before submitting.
conversation.retry: I couldn’t read that reply just now. Your draft is still here. Please send it again, or skip these details for now.
conversation.reviewed: I reviewed and corrected the collected details before submitting.

shortQuestions.maintenance_medications: Do you take any regular medications?
shortQuestions.duration: How long has it been going on?
shortQuestions.reported_severity: How strong is it, or how does it affect what you can do?
shortQuestions.worsening: Is it getting worse, improving, or staying the same?
shortQuestions.tests_completed: Any tests already done? Names only.
shortQuestions.tests_requested: Any tests requested by a clinician? Names only.
shortQuestions.medical_devices: Do you use any medical device or catheter?
